name: Fluted Cup with Dragon Handle
dimensions: Diameter: 9 cm (3 9/16 in.); Overall: 6 cm (2 3/8 in.)
summary: Very thinly potted, the subtly lobed body of this cup is almost translucent. The thin, slightly opaque, light greenish glaze lends a sugary shine.
